seoTitle: Domain Hosting Checker for IP and Network Details
metaDescription: Look up public IP addresses for a domain and inspect the registered network when available.
intro: Look up public IP addresses for a domain and inspect the registered network when available.
aboutTitle: Which hosting details can this check reveal?
about: The tool resolves the domain and uses public IP registration data to report an assigned network. A CDN or proxy can be the visible network even when the site is hosted elsewhere.
exampleTitle: Investigate a domain behind a CDN
example: Enter the domain and compare its public IPs and network record with your DNS or hosting dashboard to identify which service is visible.

faqs.question: Can it find the private origin server behind a CDN?
faqs.answer: The result describes the public addresses it can resolve. Use your own provider dashboard to confirm the origin setup.
